warnings: Uncertainties use Larch's high-R noise estimate; systematic model errors are not included.
FEFF: FEFF path degeneracies are retained; the absorber site's crystallographic multiplicity is not an additional amplitude multiplier.
FEFF: FEFF reported a path-radius warning. ATOMS reaches 5.89501 Å; requested RPATH is 4 Å. The native diagnostic disagrees with the input geometry; retain the log for review.
Demo review: Reduced chi-square is 225.98 using Larch's high-R noise estimate. The residual is large relative to that estimate; the reported parameter errors do not cover complete systematic errors.
Demo review: Delta E0 is +13.00 eV and correlates with the Ni-Ni distance shift (0.875). It is a theoretical threshold offset, not a beam-energy calibration or an oxidation-state shift.

Demo review: Effective S0 squared is uncalibrated, with Ni-O/Ni-Ni coordination fixed at 6/12. Amplitude/disorder correlation reaches 0.879; this demo does not independently measure coordination or defect concentration.
Demo review: This two-shell model fits only R = 1-3 angstrom. Systematic residuals remain near the lower R boundary; higher-shell contributions outside the fitted interval are omitted.
